claude.performance_metric: no divestiture or write-down; combined with Euronext ~13 months after close (Apr 2007)
claude.rationale: Per section 2, T4 (ArcaEx electronic platform, renamed NYSE Arca) and its T5 operating/trading technology transferred together with a stated aim of enhancing both markets' technology, so no product-vs-process mismatch at closing (gap_45=0). Section 2 shows T5 operations and T6 membership/ownership conversion proceeding together to close with no documented process-vs-organization misalignment (gap_56=0). Section 4 documents "None documented" for both the P4 product-process interface and the P5 process-organization interface at the 3-5yr horizon, so p4_pathway=0 and p5_pathway=0. The demutualization was the explicit and achieved purpose with the two exchange models treated as complementary (t1_archetype=0, t2_model=0).

gemini.performance_metric: no divestiture or write-down; expanded via Euronext combination ~13 months after close
gemini.rationale: The dossier documents that the electronic platform (T4) and its trading technology (T5) transferred together, resulting in no structural gap (gap_45=0) and no subsequent product-process disruption (p4_pathway=0). Similarly, membership conversion and operations proceeded together to close without a process-organization mismatch (gap_56=0), and no post-deal fracture occurred at this interface (p5_pathway=0).

grok.performance_metric: no divestiture or write-down; expanded to Euronext 13 months later
grok.rationale: Section 2 states T4 (NYSE floor + ArcaEx) and T5 (floor auction + electronic trading technology) transferred together into NYSE Group with the explicit aim of enhancing both; section 4 confirms no P4 or P5 disruption documented at 3-5yr horizon. Section 2 also shows T5 and T6 (membership conversion to NYSE Group shares) moved in lockstep at closing with no structural mismatch noted. Section 5 confirms no transitional-services gap existed because this was a full combination into a single new parent.
